existing_order.behavior: Captures one immutable physical-evidence snapshot, then queries the registry fragments present when each identity is visited. Scalar SurfaceEvidence is copied; source indices/cells and fragment version are not carried to the reducer.
Verifies current states before mesh reconciliation while the ray index still matches the queried geometry; optionally finalizes pending absences, then updates closed background.
Canonicalization ingests extractor segments after the state-evidence pass. Only terminal finalize_pending rebuilds the index and drains these newly ingested segments at the same terminal stamp.

protected_compensation: Do not simply move canonicalization before change detection or rerun on a stale ray index. Existing comments identify why visibility segments must remain separate for old-site deletion and why terminal drain is needed for Synthetic A I69.
what_is_proved: A per-pass frozen sensor snapshot already exists. Missing all-session snapshot freezing is not an accurate diagnosis.
Fresh extractor fragments can be ingested after the preceding registry-evidence decision; a stamp alone does not bind evidence to a fragment/version.
The real I6 difference observed in logs is compatible with the differing cycle in which the same segment becomes available. No native scheduler cause is proved.

remaining_joint_obligations.prior: Unique physical transitions must contribute once; all identities in an event must condition on the same history, without MAP actions retraining their own prior.
remaining_joint_obligations.likelihood: Keep acquired source, actual query location, fragment/version and selected-error calibration together. Geometry reconstructed from depth is not a second independent observation.
remaining_joint_obligations.decision: Completion, movement, absence and invalid/stale candidate observations must be distinguished in one joint state. Materialize/absorb/close/archive must all consume it; association confidence alone cannot justify dropping valid new geometry.

next_fast_verification: Use existing frozen library/lifecycle fixtures to hold observation packets and fragment-arrival order fixed. Verify equivalent repeated callbacks add no evidence and a measurement cannot certify a successor fragment. Test actual movement, opposite-face completion and weak/spurious copy jointly before a new listed source trial.
validation_contract: Keep fixed input, sampling, params, scores and0.2pp gate; use event-locked fast checks to diagnose cause, not to replace online acceptance.
